_comment: Standards row: names and one-line roles only; no third-party logos we do not have rights to use. The first four are implemented in the code (GS1 Digital Link resolution, W3C VC 2.0 credentials, did:web identity, AAS export), checked 2026-09-25. The fifth is the set of six harmonised DPP standards cited by Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1736 (OJ 15.7.2026: EN 18216, 18219, 18220, 18221, 18222, 18223; not a range, there is no 18217 or 18218). Alignment with them is work in progress, and the row says so.

standards.name: W3C Verifiable Credentials
standards.role: The format of every signed passport

standards.role: Issuer identity, anchored in your own web domain

standards.role: The six harmonised standards cited in July 2026. Alignment in progress
